keypoints.name: Flight Controller
keypoints.description: The flight controller is the hardware responsible for the inner loop control of a drone, focusing on stabilizing the vehicle. It receives commands and sensor data, processes them quickly, and sends signals to the motors.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced early and developed in a dedicated section. Mentioned multiple times and its role is contrasted with the flight computer.
representative_quotes: We call the board that handles interloop control the flight controller.
The flight controller is a dedicated board to simply stabilize the vehicle

keypoints.name: Flight Computer
keypoints.description: The flight computer handles outer loop control, acts as the 'brain' making decisions based on sensor data and mission objectives. It sends vehicle state requests to the flight controller, like a pilot.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced early and developed in a dedicated section. Mentioned frequently and its role is contrasted with the flight controller.
representative_quotes: A flight computer is what is used to conduct all outerloop control
the flight computer performs all the onboard decision-making and sensing, much like a pilot

keypoints.name: Interloop vs Outerloop Control
keypoints.description: The video covers the concepts of inner and outer control loops in autonomous drones. The interloop stabilizes the drone and the outerloop handles decision-making and navigation.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Covered in a dedicated section, with multiple mentions of the two loops and their differences.
